name: Victor's Office (1F)
description: The first floor of Victor's company building, serving as the main office area. Tom and Lisa each have a desk with a computer. A filing cabinet and water cooler sit against the wall. A staircase at the back leads to the second floor. Victor's private office is partitioned off in the corner with a glass door and half-closed blinds.

items.name: Office Computer
items.description: A desktop computer on Tom's work desk, currently showing a spreadsheet.

items.name: Filing Cabinet
items.description: A metal filing cabinet containing company documents and invoices. The bottom drawer has a separate lock.

items.name: Water Cooler
items.description: A water cooler in the corner, the social gathering spot during breaks.

items.name: Petty Cash Box
items.description: A small metal cash box in Victor's desk drawer. It should contain the company's petty cash fund.

items.name: Overtime Request Form
items.description: A stack of blank overtime request forms on Victor's desk. Several recent ones are marked 'DENIED' in red ink.

conditions.description: A standard office environment with fluorescent lighting and the hum of computers. Victor's private office corner has blinds that he often keeps half-closed.
